groups.title: Public Safety Division 4
groups.def: The core named human, fiend, and hybrid hunters of Tokyo Special Division 4 who get significant screen time — not one-off background members.

groups.title: Wild Devils
groups.def: Devils encountered on their own terms, not under contract to Public Safety.

groups.title: Introduced in the Intro Arc
groups.def: Characters who debut in the very first episodes, before Denji formally joins Public Safety Division 4.

groups.title: Introduced in the Eternity Devil Arc
groups.def: Characters who debut during the Eternity Devil Arc.

groups.title: Devils & Fiends Serving Public Safety
groups.def: Devils and fiends who fight on Public Safety's side, whether under an individual hunter's contract or as hunters themselves.

groups.title: Introduced in the Bat Devil Arc
groups.def: Characters who debut during the Bat Devil Arc.

groups.title: Made a Devil Contract
groups.def: Humans, not hybrids, who have made a contract with a devil, trading something of theirs for its power.

groups.title: New Hunters of the Katana Man Arc
groups.def: Public Safety hunters, human or devil, first introduced as reinforcements during the Katana Man Arc.

groups.title: Introduced in the Katana Man Arc
groups.def: Every named character, on either side, who debuts during the Katana Man Arc.

groups.title: Contracted Devils Known Only By Type
groups.def: Devils under contract who have no revealed proper name of their own, going only by a generic '[X] Devil' label — unlike Spider Devil, whose real name (Princi) has been shown.
